name: deploy-info.md
html:
shared/scripts/build/deploy-info.mjs

Assembles dist/deploy-info/ — the "last deploy" bundle the CMS
Sourcesrc/shared/scripts/build/deploy-info.mjs
UX surfaceThe repo verbs — build, verify, test, docs, i18n, media, setup, scaffold.

Members

COVERAGE_MODULES

Module workspaces that publish a coverage report — mirrors the run-modules.mjs runner order.

fileSize

Byte size of a file, or null when absent.

unminifiedSize

Unminified source size for a built asset — the emitted .map carries sourcesContent (the pre-minification module text); summing byte lengths reproduces what the bundle weighed before terser/lightningcss.

  • @param {string} file Emitted bundle path.
  • @returns {number|null} Summed source bytes, or null without a map.

walk

Recursive generator — yields every file path under dir.

fileSizes

Sizes for one emitted file: raw bytes plus compressed bytes — the build's precompressed .gz/.br siblings when they exist (vite's compression emits them next to every bundled asset), computed via zlib for smaller strays that ship uncompressed.

  • @param {string} file Emitted file path.
  • @returns {{bytes:number,gzip:number,brotli:number}} Size triple.

blank

Blank file-type bucket — counts plus minified/unminified/compressed bytes.

acc

Folds one file's sizes (+ optional unminified bytes) into a bucket.

collectTier

Scans one tier tree (dist/v//): JS + CSS bundles with source-map unminified sizes, misc emitted payloads (fonts/wasm spills), and the ten largest chunks for the CMS "heaviest output" list.

  • @param {string} dir dist/v/ path.
  • @returns {{js:object,css:object,misc:object,largest:Array}}

collectWasmCrates

Per-crate wasm table — .wasm module bytes + .js glue bytes each.

collectBundleStats

Full dist/ bundle inventory: a file-type rollup (js, css, html, wasm, assets) with minified/unminified/compressed bytes, the per-tier breakdown, the per-crate wasm table, and HTML grouped by top-level directory (the prerendered locale trees).

  • @returns {object|null} The bundle-stats report, or null without dist/.
